info.title: Hacktron REST API
info.description: Public REST API for programmatic access to Hacktron

resolved_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent transition to resolved (ISO 8601). Null if never resolved.

state_reason.description: Reason for the state change (defaults to reason if omitted)

severity_reason.description: Reason for the severity change (defaults to reason if omitted)

reason.description: Shorthand reason applied to both state and severity changes when their specific reason is not provided

duplicate_of.description: UUID of the canonical finding to mark this finding as a duplicate of, or null to unmark. The target must be in the same repository.
UUID of the canonical finding this duplicates, if any.

detail.description: Raw symbol docstring; supplemental context for the stepped taint flow.

code.description: Source code lines for this step's symbol, pre-sliced by the worker.

code_start_line.description: 1-based start line number of the `code` slice in the source file. Used by the frontend as the anchor for chevron-expand requests to GET /findings/:uuid/source.

code_end_line.description: 1-based end line number of the `code` slice in the source file. Used by the frontend as the anchor for chevron-expand requests to GET /findings/:uuid/source.

resolved_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent transition to resolved (ISO 8601). Null if never resolved.

github_installation_id.description: GitHub App installation ID. Omitted for PAT-based connections (e.g. GitHub Enterprise), where the installation is resolved from repo_url and the organization instead.

from_cache.description: Whether result was served from cache

unsupported_languages.description: Detected unsupported languages among the top languages

total_credits.description: Total estimated credits across all repos

triage_required.description: Whether human triage is mandatory for a scan of this estimation (large app, above the predicted-cost threshold). The customer cannot opt out when true.

triage_fee_credits.description: Triage fee in credits (a percentage of the scan base credits) added when triage is enabled

updated_at.description: Timestamp when estimation was last updated

name.description: Display name (owner/repo for GitHub, namespace/project for GitLab, workspace/slug for Bitbucket)

providerKey.description: Provider-native identifier for mutation endpoints. GitHub: owner/repo, GitLab: numeric projectId (as string), Bitbucket: repository UUID.

enabled.description: Whether the repository is enabled for scanning

threatModelUpdatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the repo's most recent threat_model.md update, or null if it has none. Repos are returned ordered by this (most recent first; repos without a threat model last).

prScansEnabled.description: Whether PR/MR scans are enabled (GitHub and GitLab)

prScanBranches.description: Target branches for PR/MR scans (GitHub and GitLab)

baseUrl.description: GitHub Enterprise base URL for self-hosted (PAT) installations. Null/absent for github.com. Clients should build clone/display URLs from this host instead of assuming github.com (GitHub only).

webhookRegistered.description: Whether a webhook is registered for this project (GitLab only)

isPrivate.description: Whether the repository is private (Bitbucket only)

repos.description: Unified list of repositories from all providers
